_note: On The Decks. 'sets' are DJ dates (future ones show under Next up, past under Recent). 'mixes' are links to recorded sets (SoundCloud, Mixcloud, YouTube); empty means the card says mixes are coming. 'dj_pack' is the pack for DJs who play his records.
intro: Rapper first, but he has been behind the decks as long as he has been on the mic. Hip-hop, dancehall, soca, afrobeats and the records he made himself, read live off the room.

formats.name: DJ set
formats.detail: 60 to 120 minutes. Open format, built for the room.

formats.name: Kardi Live
formats.detail: A DJ set with the hits performed live over it. The festival version.

formats.name: Host + DJ
formats.detail: He holds the mic and the decks. Brand launches, galas, award nights.

formats.name: Private + corporate
formats.detail: Closed-door events, holiday parties, conferences. Quietly, professionally.

dj_pack.name: SOAK DJ pack
dj_pack.detail: Clean, dirty, acapella and instrumental at 100 BPM, for DJs who play it out.
